# 2 Baruch Chapter 74 — The PNEUMA Bible (Dynamic)
**Translator:** PNEUMA | **Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision

---

**1** "At that time the storehouse of manna will open again from on high, and they will eat from it in those years — for these are those who have reached the completion of time."

**2** When I had heard all these things from the angel Ramiel, I was deeply comforted.

**3** I said: "Blessed is the person born in those days, who is alive at that time! He will see all the good things that are prepared for those who love the Lord."

**4** "But I am deeply sad, grieving over all the trouble that has fallen on Israel. O Mighty One, you know what you have prepared for the righteous and what you have prepared for those who transgress."

---

*PNEUMA notes: Dynamic equivalence rendering. Prioritizes clarity and natural English flow while preserving the theological and narrative content of the Syriac source.*
